stories.hook: ¿Por qué la depresión altera el cerebro y el sistema inmune?
stories.headline: Depresión adolescente se asocia a deterioro cognitivo, anomalías ERP e inflamación inmunitaria
stories.finding: En 89 adolescentes con MDD y 30 controles, los pacientes obtuvieron puntuaciones MoCA significativamente menores, sobre todo en atención, recuerdo retardado y función ejecutiva. También presentaron latencias ERP prolongadas, amplitudes reducidas, mayores niveles séricos de IL‑1β e IL‑6 y aumentos de CD3⁺CD4⁺ y CD3⁺CD8⁺.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que el deterioro cognitivo en la depresión adolescente está vinculado a alteraciones neurofisiológicas y a una respuesta inflamatoria, ofreciendo potenciales biomarcadores para diagnóstico temprano y nuevas dianas terapéuticas.
stories.paperTitle: Association of Cognitive Function With Event‐Related Potentials and Immune Inflammation in Adolescents With Major Depressive Disorder
stories.originalAbstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to investigate cognitive function changes in adolescents with major depressive disorder (MDD) and examine their associations with depression severity, event-related potentials (ERP), T lymphocyte subsets, and inflammatory cytokines to identify exploratory clinical and biological correlates for cognitive impairment in this population. METHODS: We enrolled 89 adolescent patients with MDD and 30 healthy controls, matched for age and gender. Cognitive function was assessed using the Montreal Cognitive Assessment Scale (MoCA), depression severity with the Hamilton Depression Scale (HAMD17), and anxiety with the Hamilton Anxiety Scale. ERP were recorded, and blood samples were analyzed for T lymphocyte subsets and inflammatory cytokines. RESULTS: Adolescents with MDD exhibited significantly lower MoCA scores, indicating cognitive impairment, particularly in attention, delayed recall, and executive function. ERP component analysis showed prolonged latencies and decreased amplitudes in the MDD group. Increased serum concentrations of interleukin-1 beta and interleukin-6, and elevated percentages of CD3+CD4+ and CD3+CD8+ cells were observed in the depressive group, with positive correlations between CD3+ cells and MoCA scores and between CD3+CD8+ cells and HAMD17 scores. CONCLUSION: Adolescents with MDD showed lower cognitive performance, which was associated with depression severity and immune-inflammatory indicators.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué fusionar pensamiento y acción intensifica el TOC?
stories.headline: La fusión pensamiento‑acción predice significativamente los síntomas obsesivo‑compulsivos en universitarios
stories.finding: Se evaluaron a 200 estudiantes universitarios mediante el Padua Inventory, el Thought‑Action Fusion Questionnaire, el Emotion Regulation Questionnaire y la Intolerance of Uncertainty Scale, analizando los datos con modelado por ecuaciones estructurales. El modelo reveló un efecto directo positivo y significativo de la fusión pensamiento‑acción sobre los síntomas obsesivo‑compulsivos.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que intervenir sobre la tendencia a fusionar pensamiento y acción podría reducir la gravedad del TOC, ofreciendo un objetivo terapéutico concreto para psicoterapias cognitivo‑conductuales y metacognitivas.
stories.paperTitle: Development of a Model of Obsessive–Compulsive Symptoms Based on Thought–Action Fusion and Emotion Regulation: The Mediating Role of Intolerance of Uncertainty among University Students in Kermanshah
stories.journal: Journal of Adolescent and Youth Psychological Studies (JAYPS)
stories.originalAbstract: Objective: This study aimed to examine a structural model of obsessive–compulsive symptoms based on thought–action fusion and emotion regulation strategies, with the mediating role of intolerance of uncertainty. Methods and Materials: The study employed an applied, descriptive–correlational design with a cross-sectional approach. The statistical population comprised all students enrolled in universities in Kermanshah during the second semester of the 2024–2025 academic year. A total of 200 students were selected using convenience sampling. Data were collected using the Padua Inventory for obsessive–compulsive symptoms, the Thought–Action Fusion Questionnaire, the Emotion Regulation Questionnaire (cognitive reappraisal and expressive suppression), and the Intolerance of Uncertainty Scale. Data analysis was conducted using SPSS (version 21) and SmartPLS (version 3). Partial least squares structural equation modeling was applied to evaluate the measurement and structural models, assess model fit, and test direct and indirect relationships among the study variables. Findings: The results indicated a positive and significant direct effect of thought–action fusion on obsessive–compulsive symptoms (β = 0.17, p < .05) and a negative and significant direct effect of cognitive reappraisal on obsessive–compulsive symptoms (β = −0.26, p < .01). Intolerance of uncertainty showed a strong positive direct effect on obsessive–compulsive symptoms (β = 0.39, p < .01). Mediation analyses revealed that intolerance of uncertainty significantly mediated the relationship between thought–action fusion and obsessive–compulsive symptoms (β = 0.15, p < .01), as well as the relationship between expressive suppression and obsessive–compulsive symptoms (β = 0.12, p < .01). The overall structural model demonstrated acceptable fit and predictive relevance. Conclusion: The findings support an integrative cognitive–emotional model in which maladaptive thought–action fusion beliefs and emotion regulation patterns contribute to obsessive–compulsive symptoms directly and indirectly through intolerance of uncertainty.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la inhalación de CO2 inducir pánico sin ataques?
stories.headline: Inhalación doble de CO2 aumenta intensidad de pánico y activación fisiológica sin incrementar ataques
stories.finding: En un ensayo cruzado con 20 voluntarios sensibles al CO2, la inhalación doble de capacidad vital generó respuestas subjetivas de pánico más intensas y activación fisiológica ampliada, aunque la ocurrencia de ataques de pánico no difería de la inhalación simple. Repetidas exposiciones mostraron habituación en marcadores endocrinos.
stories.takeaway: El hallazgo refuerza la utilidad del modelo de inhalación de CO2 doble como herramienta para evaluar la intensidad de pánico y la respuesta fisiológica en estudios de fármacos ansiolíticos, permitiendo distinguir efectos subjetivos de fisiológicos y observar la habituación.
stories.paperTitle: The 35% CO2 inhalation panic challenge in early clinical anxiolytic drug development: Addressing current methodological limitations
stories.originalAbstract: We evaluated methodological properties of the 35% CO 2 inhalation challenge as a panic model to optimize use in anxiolytic drug development. Twenty CO 2 -sensitive healthy volunteers – who participated 3-5 years ago and were sensitive to the fear-inducing effects of the CO2 challenge - completed a randomized open-label crossover comparing single versus double vital-capacity (VC) inhalations, followed by three additional weekly double-VC challenges. Subjective panic symptoms and fear were assessed using the Panic Symptom List-IV, standard visual analog scales, and a continuous real-time fear rating, alongside beat-to-beat cardiovascular monitoring and repeated plasma and salivary neuroendocrine measures. Binary panic-attack occurrence did not differ between single and double VC inhalation, but double VC produced significantly larger intensity-based subjective responses and broader physiological activation, including blood pressure and endocrine changes. Across repeated double-VC challenges, several subjective and endocrine outcomes showed significant attenuation consistent with habituation, whereas cardiovascular peak responses were relatively stable and cardiovascular parameters demonstrated the highest test–retest reliability. Individual sensitivity to CO 2 -induced panic remained largely stable over several years within this population. These findings support using double VC to maximize signal in pharmacology studies, incorporating habituation into design and analysis, and prioritizing robust cardiovascular endpoints; single VC may be sufficient for screening.

stories.hook: ¿Puede una IA mejorar la reestructuración cognitiva?
stories.headline: Interacción con modelo de lenguaje potencia la reestructuración cognitiva en usuarios
stories.finding: En un estudio de campo aleatorizado con 15 531 participantes, se evaluó un sistema que emplea modelos de lenguaje para guiar la reestructuración cognitiva. El sistema mejoró la intensidad emocional en el 67 % de los usuarios y permitió superar pensamientos negativos en el 65 %.
stories.takeaway: Demuestra que la IA puede ampliar el acceso y la efectividad de intervenciones basadas en TCC, ofreciendo apoyo escalable y personalizado, lo que puede transformar la práctica clínica y reducir brechas de equidad en salud mental.
stories.paperTitle: Facilitating Self-Guided Mental Health Interventions Through Human-Language Model Interaction: A Case Study of Cognitive Restructuring
stories.journal: CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
stories.originalAbstract: Self-guided mental health interventions, such as “do-it-yourself” tools to learn and practice coping strategies, show great promise to improve access to mental health care. However, these interventions are often cognitively demanding and emotionally triggering, creating accessibility barriers that limit their wide-scale implementation and adoption. In this paper, we study how human-language model interaction can support self-guided mental health interventions. We take cognitive restructuring, an evidence-based therapeutic technique to overcome negative thinking, as a case study. In an IRB-approved randomized field study on a large mental health website with 15,531 participants, we design and evaluate a system that uses language models to support people through various steps of cognitive restructuring. Our findings reveal that our system positively impacts emotional intensity for 67% of participants and helps 65% overcome negative thoughts. Although adolescents report relatively worse outcomes, we find that tailored interventions that simplify language model generations improve overall effectiveness and equity.

stories.hook: ¿EMDR o TF‑CBT: cuál alivia mejor el trauma?
stories.headline: EMDR y TF‑CBT reducen síntomas en mujeres víctimas de abuso sexual infantil
stories.finding: En un ensayo controlado aleatorizado con 19 mujeres que habían sufrido abuso sexual en la infancia, se comparó la eficacia de EMDR y de la terapia cognitivo‑conductual focalizada en el trauma (TF‑CBT) en formato grupal online. Ambas intervenciones disminuyeron significativamente la sintomatología post‑traumática evaluada.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que tanto EMDR como TF‑CBT son opciones efectivas y viables en formato grupal virtual para tratar secuelas de abuso sexual infantil, ampliando las herramientas clínicas disponibles y facilitando el acceso a tratamiento especializado.
stories.paperTitle: Psychological intervention in women victims of childhood sexual abuse: a randomized controlled clinical trial comparing EMDR psychotherapy and trauma-focused cognitive behavioral therapy
stories.originalAbstract: Introduction: Childhood sexual abuse persists as a painful societal reality, necessitating responses from institutions and healthcare professionals to prevent and address its severe long-term consequences in victims. This study implements an intervention comprising two psychotherapeutic approaches recommended by the WHO and international clinical guidelines for addressing short-, medium-, and long-term posttraumatic symptomatology: Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (TF-CBT) and Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). Both approaches are adapted from group formats for implementation in small online groups via Zoom. Methods: The impact of both therapeutic approaches on trauma improvement was assessed in a sample of 19 women who were victims of childhood sexual abuse through a Randomized Clinical Trial comparing EMDR Psychotherapy and Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy after a baseline period. Intra and inter comparison were made using statistics appropriate to the sample. Results: Both therapeutic approaches significantly reduced symptomatology across various evaluated variables, suggesting their efficacy in improving the quality of life for these individuals. Following CBT-FT treatment, patients exhibited enhanced emotional regulation, reduced reexperiencing, and avoidance. The EMDR group, utilizing the G-TEP group protocol, significantly improved dissociation, along with other crucial clinical variables and the perception of quality of life. Discussion: Although the limitations of this study must be taken into account due to the size of the sample and the lack of long-term follow-up, the results align with existing scientific literature, underscoring the benefits of trauma-focused psychological treatments. The online group format appears promising for enhancing the accessibility of psychological treatment for these women. Furthermore, the differential outcomes of each treatment support recent research advocating for the inclusion of both approaches for individuals with trauma-related symptomatology. Ethics and dissemination: The study has been approved by the Ethics Committee of the Valencian International University (VIU) (Valencia, Spain) (Ref. CEID2021_07). The results will be submitted for publication in peer-reviewed journals and disseminated to the scientific community. Clinical trial registration: https://clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/NCT04813224, identifier NCT04813224.

stories.hook: ¿Qué constructos median entre trauma y síntomas psiquiátricos?
stories.headline: Organización de la personalidad y hipomentalización median trauma y gravedad sintomática
stories.finding: El análisis de red en 498 participantes mostró que la organización de la personalidad, la tristeza (SADNESS) y la hipomentalización fueron los constructos más influyentes. Estos dos constructos también presentaron la mayor centralidad de puente, indicando su potencial como mediadores entre trauma, afectos primarios y gravedad sintomática.
stories.takeaway: Identificar a la organización de la personalidad y la hipomentalización como puentes entre trauma y síntomas sugiere que intervenciones que fortalezcan la mentalización y la estructuración del yo podrían reducir la gravedad clínica, orientando tratamientos psicodinámicos y preventivos.
stories.paperTitle: Trauma, personality structure and psychopathology: a cartography of psychodynamic constructs
stories.journal: Borderline Personality Disorder and Emotion Dysregulation
stories.originalAbstract: BACKGROUND: In this study, network analysis technique is applied to dissect the links between personality organization, reflective functioning, attachment security, primary affective traits, childhood trauma and psychopathological symptoms. METHODS: A total sample of 498 (77% female) participants from the general population was investigated. A cross-sectional network between personality organization [IPO-16], hypomentalizing [RFQ-6], attachment [ECR-RD8]), primary affective traits [BANPS-GL], depression, anxiety and somatization symptoms [BSI-18], addiction [WHO-ASSIST] and childhood trauma [CTQ] was estimated via the EBICglasso and relimp algorithm. Regularized partial correlation edge weights, node centrality, predictability, bridge centrality, relative importance and stability coefficients were analyzed. RESULTS: We observed personality organization, SADNESS and hypomentalizing as the most influential personality constructs within the investigated network. Personality organization and hypomentalizing were also observed as nodes with the highest bridge centrality, signifying their potential relevance as mediator between trauma, affect and psychiatric symptom severity. CONCLUSIONS: The results enable a data-driven, in-depth examination of the complex and often reciprocal relations among psychopathological symptoms, childhood adversity and psychodynamic personality constructs. Our observations highlight critical interconnections among childhood trauma, primary affects, personality functioning and psychopathology and pinpoint personality organization, hypomentalizing and SADNESS as central psychodynamic personality constructs.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la instrucción mejorar la empatía en psicópatas?
stories.headline: Instrucciones de perspectiva aumentan la preocupación empática incluso en individuos con alta psicopatía
stories.finding: En un experimento preregistrado con 87 adultos, la instrucción de imaginar‑self u‑other elevó la preocupación empática frente a la condición sin instrucción. La meanness psicopática interactuó con esta manipulación, de modo que los participantes con alta psicopatía mostraron menor empatía sin instrucción pero aumentaron significativamente al adoptar la perspectiva del otro.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la empatía en personas con rasgos psicopáticos no es fija, sino modulable mediante instrucciones de perspectiva, lo que abre posibilidades terapéuticas basadas en entrenamiento de mentalización para reducir conductas antisociales.
stories.paperTitle: Behavioral and physiological insights into the interplay of affective perspective taking and psychopathic traits
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Humans typically default to affective perspective taking when encountering someone in distress. However, this does not appear to be the case for individuals with high levels of psychopathy, which may contribute to their diminished empathic behavior. The question therefore arises whether empathy deficits related to psychopathy can be overcome, if one is explicitly instructed to engage in affective perspective taking. We tested this in a preregistered experimental study involving 87 participants (51% women) from the community. Participants were presented with images of distressed individuals, and initially not given any instructions (i.e., default response). Subsequently, they were instructed to imagine how they themselves would feel in the situation (i.e., imagine-self), how the other person feels in the situation (i.e., imagine-other), and to remain objective about what has happened to the person depicted (i.e., remain-objective). For each presented image, participants rated their level of empathic concern. In addition, skin conductance responses and heart rate were recorded throughout the task. The results revealed an interaction between psychopathic meanness and experimental conditions, wherein empathic concern ratings were lower at higher levels of meanness, but this was mitigated when individuals were deliberately engaging in affective perspective taking (i.e., imagine-self and imagine-other). No equivalent interaction effect was found for physiological responses. Our findings support the motivational framework of psychopathy, suggesting that empathy deficits in psychopathy do not indicate a general incapacity to empathize, but rather a reduced tendency to do so by default.

stories.headline: Calidad del sueño se asocia a peor salud gastrointestinal
stories.finding: En un estudio transversal con 303 adultos de 20 a 40 años, la peor calidad del sueño, medida con el PSQI, se relacionó significativamente con mayor presencia de síntomas gastrointestinales, incluyendo IBS, GERD e IBD. Estos resultados persisten tras controlar estrés, dieta y actividad física.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la evaluación y mejora de la calidad del sueño podrían ser una estrategia clínica útil para prevenir o aliviar trastornos gastrointestinales, integrando intervenciones de higiene del sueño en el manejo de pacientes con síntomas digestivos.
stories.paperTitle: EFFECT OF SLEEP QUALITY ON GIT HEALTH
stories.originalAbstract: Background: Sleep plays a fundamental role in physiological regulation, influencing cognitive, emotional, and metabolic processes. Recent evidence emphasizes its impact on gastrointestinal (GI) health, particularly through the gut-brain axis, circadian rhythms, and gut microbiota. Sleep disturbances have been strongly linked to GI conditions such as irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). However, the exact biological mechanisms underlying this relationship remain incompletely understood, necessitating further exploration. Objective: This study aimed to assess the impact of sleep quality on gastrointestinal health, with a focus on gut microbiota balance, circadian disruptions, and GI symptoms, while evaluating potential contributing factors such as stress, diet, and physical activity. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted over four months involving 303 adults aged 20–40 years. Participants were recruited from Superior University Lahore and online platforms. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire, including the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) and a GI symptom checklist. Demographic variables and lifestyle factors were controlled. Data analysis was performed using SPSS version 26, applying chi-square tests, independent t-tests, ANOVA, and logistic regression to determine the association between sleep parameters and GI outcomes. Results: Among 303 participants, 39.3% reported poor sleep quality. Gastrointestinal discomfort was significantly higher in this group (mean GI score = 6.8, SD = 2.3) compared to those with good sleep (mean = 3.2, SD = 1.8). Regression analysis showed sleep quality as a strong predictor of GI symptoms (β = 0.52, p < 0.001). Circadian misalignment was also significantly associated with increased digestive disturbances (χ² = 9.72, p = 0.002). Conclusion: The findings underscore a significant association between poor sleep and gastrointestinal dysfunction. Enhancing sleep hygiene may play a crucial role in alleviating GI symptoms, supporting the integration of sleep-focused interventions in clinical management.

stories.hook: ¿Puede una mentalidad de crecimiento impulsar el uso de apps de salud?
stories.headline: Intervención de mentalidad de crecimiento aumenta la re‑enganchación en apps de salud mental
stories.finding: En un ensayo controlado aleatorizado con 252 participantes, una breve intervención que presenta la salud mental como mejorable incrementó la probabilidad de que los usuarios volvieran a usar una característica de auto‑ayuda de la app, especialmente entre quienes presentaban mayor estrés, ansiedad y depresión al inicio. Además, los efectos fueron más pronunciados en los que tenían peor bienestar mental basal.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que modificar creencias sobre la plasticidad de la salud mental puede mejorar la adherencia a intervenciones digitales, ofreciendo una estrategia sencilla para potenciar el impacto terapéutico de apps en poblaciones con alta carga sintomática.
stories.paperTitle: A “growth mindset of mental health” intervention increases the likelihood of initiating self-help on a mental health app: a randomized controlled trial
stories.originalAbstract: Mental health apps hold potential to improve access to treatment, but engagement remains low. One barrier may be the belief that mental health cannot be meaningfully improved. In a randomized controlled trial (N = 252), we examined whether a brief growth-mindset-of-mental-health intervention-portraying mental health as improvable, not fixed-can initiate mental health app engagement among people with mental health needs. Participants completed baseline well-being measures (stress, anxiety and depression, and positive mental well-being) and were randomly assigned to the growth-mindset-of-mental-health or active control condition. Over the subsequent three months, we tracked whether they re-engaged with the app overall (i.e., completed at least a second self-help feature), and with features categorized as low-, moderate-, and high-intensity. Analyses revealed that participants in the growth-mindset condition (vs. control) with poorer baseline mental well-being (i.e., higher stress, anxiety and depressive symptoms, and lower positive mental well-being) were significantly more likely to show repeat app engagement. Moreover, those with higher anxiety and depressive symptoms were more likely to show repeat engagement with moderate-intensity features, while those experiencing higher stress and lower positive mental well-being were more likely to do so with both low- and moderate-intensity features. Together, these findings demonstrate the benefits of the growth-mindset intervention for successful initiation of self-help on a mental health app. Trial Registration: The trial was registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (Identifier: NCT07071311) on July 25, 2025.

stories.hook: ¿Reducir la autocrítica mejora el bienestar psicológico?
stories.headline: Menor autocrítica se asocia a mayor bienestar psicológico en estudiantes vocacionales
stories.finding: El estudio incluyó a 1812 estudiantes vocacionales que completaron escalas de autocrítica y bienestar psicológico. Los resultados mostraron puntuaciones medias (M = 60.34 ± 2.86 y M = 118.48 ± 2.53) y una disminución de la autocrítica se relacionó significativamente con un mayor bienestar.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo indica que intervenir para disminuir la autocrítica puede fortalecer el bienestar en jóvenes en formación, ofreciendo una vía práctica para programas de prevención y mejora de la salud mental en contextos educativos.
stories.paperTitle: Self-Criticism and Psychological Well-being: A Study to Find Out the Relationship and Influence on Vocational Students
stories.originalAbstract: Important for vocational students to achieve psychological well-being amidst technological developments that increase self-critical behaviour. Information overload, increased self-com, and other psychological health issues can increase self-critical behaviour. This can hinder the achievement of the six dimensions of psychological well-being. So, it is necessary to know the correlation between these two variables in vocational students. This study aims to determine the relationship between self-criticism on psychological well-being in vocational students. A total of 1812 students were included, and participants completed assessments of self‐criticism and psychological well-being. The result is self-criticism and psychological well-being is in a medium category with scores M = 60.34; SD = 2.86 and M = 118.48; SD = 2.53 sequentially. Analyses assessed the extent to which the intercept and linear slope of self‐criticism were associated with assessments of psychological well‐being. Findings suggest that a decrease in self-criticism is associated with better psychological well-being in vocational students. There was a relationship between self-criticism and psychological well-being. The implication of this finding suggests applying intervention with a focus on reducing self-criticism to improve student’s psychological well-being.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el liderazgo reducir el agotamiento emocional docente?
stories.headline: El liderazgo que apoya la autonomía disminuye el agotamiento emocional en docentes
stories.finding: El liderazgo que favorece la autonomía se relacionó positivamente con las cinco dimensiones de la competencia socioemocional percibida por los docentes. Además, la competencia percibida en asertividad se asoció a menor agotamiento emocional, mientras que la tolerancia y la regulación emocional se vincularon a mayor compromiso organizacional.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que promover un liderazgo que apoye la autonomía y fortalecer la competencia en asertividad y regulación emocional pueden ser estrategias efectivas para prevenir el burnout docente y mejorar el compromiso institucional.
stories.paperTitle: Teachers’ perceived social-emotional competence: a multidimensional examination and links with leadership practices, commitment, and emotional exhaustion
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract There is growing attention to the importance of teachers’ social-emotional capability beliefs. However, existing research has generally been narrow in how it operationalizes these constructs. This study sought to advance knowledge of a social-emotional capability belief, perceived social-emotional competence (PSEC), comprising five dimensions: perceived competence for assertiveness, tolerance, social regulation, emotion regulation, and emotional awareness. Specifically, the five PSEC dimensions were examined in relation to two hypothesized predictors, autonomy-supportive and autonomy-thwarting leadership, and in turn in relation to two hypothesized outcomes, organizational commitment and emotional exhaustion. Using structural equation modeling involving cross-sectional data from 473 Australian teachers, findings showed that autonomy-supportive leadership was positively associated with all five PSEC dimensions, whereas autonomy-thwarting leadership was not associated with any dimension. In turn, perceived competence for tolerance and emotion regulation were associated with greater organizational commitment. Perceived competence for assertiveness was associated with lower emotional exhaustion, whereas perceived competence for social regulation was associated with greater emotional exhaustion. In addition, autonomy-supportive leadership was directly associated with greater organizational commitment, and autonomy-thwarting leadership was directly associated with greater emotional exhaustion. These findings hold implications for better understanding how to support teachers’ social-emotional experiences at work.

stories.hook: ¿Puede una nueva medida predecir mejor la necesidad de terapia de pareja?
stories.headline: El Couple Flourishing Measure supera al Dyadic Adjustment Scale para identificar parejas en terapia
stories.finding: En una muestra española de 118 adultos, el Couple Flourishing Measure discriminó mejor entre pacientes de terapia (n=67) y comunidad (n=51) que la Dyadic Adjustment Scale (AUC = 0.81 vs 0.71). El punto de corte propuesto (61.5) mostró sensibilidad de 0.64 y especificidad de 0.94.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que el CFM puede ser una herramienta más precisa para identificar parejas que requieren intervención terapéutica, facilitando decisiones clínicas y mejorando la detección temprana del malestar relacional.
stories.paperTitle: Criterion‐Related Validity of the Couple Flourishing Measure in a Spanish Population: Distinguishing Outpatients From Community Participants
stories.originalAbstract: Relational (or couple) well-being has begun to be conceived from an integrative perspective that transcends mere satisfaction or stability in couples and may include dimensions such as emotional connection, joint growth, and shared purpose. This study evaluated the criterion-related validity of the Couple Flourishing Measure (CFM) in comparison with the Dyadic Adjustment Scale (DAS) in a Spanish sample of people in affective-sexual relationships (n = 118; Mage = 40.3, SD = 8.77). Differences between participants receiving affective-sexual therapy services (n = 67) and community participants (n = 51) were analyzed, as well as their discriminative ability using ROC curves. The results showed that the CFM had a greater ability to discriminate between the two groups (AUC = 0.81, 95% CI [0.74, 0.89]) than the DAS (AUC = 0.71, 95% CI [0.62, 0.81]). In turn, a preliminary cutoff score for CFM was identified (61.5), with moderate sensitivity (0.64) and high specificity (0.94). These findings provide preliminary evidence supporting the criterion-related validity of the CFM for distinguishing outpatients receiving affective-sexual therapy from community participants without previous therapeutic experience and suggest that the measure may offer complementary information beyond traditional indicators of relationship adjustment. Implications, limitations, and directions for future research are discussed.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el lenguaje cambiar la percepción del delito sexual?
stories.headline: Etiquetas no modifican actitudes negativas hacia agresores sexuales, según estudio experimental
stories.finding: En un experimento con ocho viñetas, los participantes evaluaron a personas que habían cometido delitos sexuales. Los resultados mostraron que las percepciones negativas persistieron sin importar si se usaba un lenguaje centrado en la persona o la etiqueta estigmatizante.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que cambiar la terminología por sí sola no basta para reducir el estigma y facilitar la reintegración de agresores sexuales, indicando la necesidad de intervenciones más profundas que aborden creencias y emociones subyacentes.
stories.paperTitle: Changing language may not be enough to change public perceptions of individuals who sexually offend
stories.journal: Sexual Offending Theory Research and Prevention
stories.originalAbstract: Negative community attitudes toward individuals who have sexually offended may hinder their reintegration, potentially leading to reoffending. The 'sex offender' label is believed to reinforce these negative perceptions. This study examines public perceptions of these individuals using person-first language compared to stigmatizing labels. Participants read one of eight public announcement vignettes and answered questions regarding their perceptions of individuals who sexually offend. Contrary to expectations, we found that participants continued to endorse negative perceptions toward these individuals irrespective of the label used, the victim's age, or the interaction of the label and the victim's age, suggesting that the labels were not perceived differently. In light of these null findings, adopting person-first language may not be enough to change societal attitudes toward individuals who sexually offend. Changing language should be considered when the goal is to treat individuals more humanely and to better align with trauma-informed and compassionate approaches when working with those who have been convicted of sexual offences.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo frenar la adicción digital en adolescentes?
stories.headline: Nuevo marco regula características adictivas de plataformas IA para proteger a adolescentes
stories.finding: El estudio revela que la normativa china actual se centra en la moderación de contenidos y en restricciones de uso, pero no aborda los rasgos de diseño adictivo de plataformas impulsadas por IA. Esta omisión genera ambigüedad conceptual y fragmentación institucional, produciendo respuestas regulatorias reactivas en lugar de preventivas.
stories.takeaway: Entender esta brecha permite a legisladores y diseñadores implementar políticas y prácticas anti‑adicción, reduciendo riesgos de salud mental en adolescentes y fomentando entornos digitales más seguros.
stories.paperTitle: Governing Addictive Design Features in AI-Driven Platforms: Regulatory Challenges and Pathways for Protecting Adolescent Digital Wellbeing in China
stories.originalAbstract: Chinese adolescents face significant mental health risks from addictive design features embedded in AI-driven digital platforms. Existing regulations inadequately address design-level addiction triggers in these environments, focusing primarily on content moderation and usage restrictions. This study identifies this gap and offers a novel framework that integrates systems theory and legal governance to regulate feedback loops between adolescents and digital platforms. Using the Adaptive Interaction Design Framework and a three-tiered typology of addictive design features, the research highlights how conceptual ambiguity and institutional fragmentation weaken regulatory efforts, resulting in reactive responses instead of proactive protection. To enhance regulatory effectiveness, this study recommends establishing a risk-tiered precautionary oversight system, providing enforceable definitions of addictive design features, mandating anti-addiction design practices and labeling, implementing economic measures like Pigouvian taxes, and fostering multi-stakeholder governance. It also emphasizes the need for cross-border coordination to address regulatory arbitrage. These policy directions aim to enhance regulatory efficacy and protect youth well-being in digital environments, contributing to ongoing international discussions on adolescent digital safety.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la salud mental positiva proteger contra el duelo prolongado?
stories.headline: La salud mental positiva reduce el duelo prolongado mediante ansiedad y depresión
stories.finding: En un estudio transversal con 385 refugiados árabes adultos, la salud mental positiva se asoció indirectamente a menores síntomas de duelo prolongado, mediada por reducciones en ansiedad y depresión. Además, la reducción del duelo mediaba la relación entre salud mental positiva y menor ansiedad y depresión.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que fortalecer la salud mental positiva podría ser una estrategia preventiva para mitigar el duelo prolongado y sus comorbilidades en poblaciones vulnerables, orientando intervenciones clínicas hacia recursos de bienestar y resiliencia.
stories.paperTitle: The protective role of positive mental health on prolonged grief disorder, anxiety and depression among bereaved refugees: cross-sectional mediation models
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Grief is a common reaction to loss; however, its persistence is subject to specific mechanisms related to the context of death, comorbidities with other mental health disorders, and individual coping status. The current study aimed to investigate the cross-sectional link between refugees’ positive mental health (PMH) and reduced prolonged grief disorder (PGD) mediated by changes in anxiety and depression and, conversely, between PMH and reduced anxiety and depression symptoms mediated by changes in prolonged grief symptoms. The present cross-sectional study involved 385 bereaved adult Arabic-speaking refugees. Data were collected via an online survey. All participants experienced prolonged grief symptoms a minimum of 6 months from the death event. The parallel mediation model showed that PMH is indirectly linked to PGD, and the significant mediation of anxiety and depression could explain this relationship. Furthermore, two simple mediation models showed that PMH is indirectly linked to anxiety and depression, and the significant mediating effect of PGD could explain this relationship. The current results confirm the role of PMH as a predisposed coping status that could reduce the risk for PGD. Increasing the level of PMH can be considered a protective factor against challenging life events such as persistent grief and related disorders.

stories.hook: ¿Los latidos binaurales mejoran la atención en adolescentes?
stories.headline: Los latidos binaurales beta aumentan la velocidad de procesamiento en estudiantes
stories.finding: En un ensayo controlado aleatorizado con 64 estudiantes de secundaria, la estimulación binaural beta produjo una interacción tiempo × grupo significativa (Wilks' λ = .692, F = 2.936, p = .005) con un tamaño de efecto ηp² = 0.168. Los análisis post‑hoc mostraron que el grupo beta mejoró notablemente la velocidad de procesamiento respecto al grupo control.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la estimulación auditiva beta puede ser una herramienta no farmacológica para potenciar la atención sostenida y el procesamiento rápido en adolescentes, ofreciendo una alternativa complementaria en la gestión del TDAH.
stories.paperTitle: The Effectiveness of Binaural Beats on Learning Focus Among Indonesian High School Students
stories.originalAbstract: Sustaining attention and learning focus is a significant challenge that significantly disrupts academic performance among adolescents, particularly high school students. This study hypothesized that Beta stimulation will primarily enhance concentration and processing speed, while Alpha stimulation will facilitate superior working memory performance. To test this hypothesis, this study aimed to evaluate the differential efficacy of Alpha and Beta binaural beats on the cognitive performance among high school students. A true experimental pre-test-post-test control group design was employed involving 64 students from SMA Negeri 1 Nganjuk, Indonesia. Cognitive domains consisting of concentration, processing speed, working memory, and cognitive flexibility were assessed using the d2 Test, Stroop Test, N-back Task, and Trail Making Test (TMT). Mixed Multivariate Analysis of Variance (Mixed MANOVA) revealed a statistically significant Time × Stimulus Group interaction (Wilks' λ = .692, F = 2.936, p = .005) with a substantial effect size (ηp² = 0.168). Post-hoc analyses demonstrated that the Beta group exhibited a significant advantage in processing speed, significantly exceeding the Control group (p = .009, 95% CI [-5.6758, -.6486]). Conversely, while the Alpha group demonstrated the greatest enhancement in working memory, this difference did not reach conventional statistical significance when compared to the Beta group (p = .072). These findings suggest that binaural beats offer a potential non-invasive intervention for school counselors and educators to optimize student learning readiness based on specific cognitive requirements, though claims regarding long-term effectiveness require careful application.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo influye el estilo parental a largo plazo?
stories.headline: Autoridad parental predice mejor regulación emocional y éxito académico tras diez años
stories.finding: En un estudio longitudinal con 200 familias durante diez años, se evaluaron regulación emocional, competencia social y rendimiento académico mediante pruebas estandarizadas. Los niños criados con estilo autoritativo alcanzaron mayor regulación emocional, mejor competencia social y superior rendimiento académico que los criados con estilos autoritario, permisivo o desatendido.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo subraya la relevancia de fomentar un estilo parental autoritativo para promover el desarrollo socioemocional y académico sostenible, orientando intervenciones preventivas y políticas de crianza a largo plazo.
stories.paperTitle: THE INFLUENCE OF PARENTAL STYLES ON CHILD DEVELOPMENT: A LONGITUDINAL STUDY
stories.originalAbstract: Parental styles play a significant role in shaping the development of children, influencing various aspects of their emotional, cognitive, and social growth. While much research has explored the immediate effects of parenting on children, few studies have examined these effects over an extended period. Understanding how different parental styles impact child development across time is essential for identifying long-term outcomes and informing parenting strategies. This study aims to investigate the long-term influence of different parental styles on child development, focusing on emotional regulation, social competence, and academic achievement. The goal is to explore how these parenting styles affect children at various developmental stages. A longitudinal design was employed, with data collected from 200 families over a span of 10 years. Parenting styles were categorized based on the authoritative, authoritarian, permissive, and uninvolved frameworks. Child development was measured using standardized assessments for emotional regulation, social competence, and academic performance. The findings revealed that children of authoritative parents showed higher levels of emotional regulation, better social skills, and stronger academic performance compared to children of authoritarian, permissive, or uninvolved parents. This study underscores the importance of authoritative parenting in fostering positive long-term outcomes in child development.

stories.headline: Los astrocitos regulan el desarrollo sináptico crítico y la salud mental
stories.finding: Los astrocitos proliferan, se diferencian y maduran durante el periodo crítico postnatal, regulando el equilibrio entre formación y eliminación sináptica. Alteraciones en su número, morfología o funciones durante esta ventana pueden provocar remodelación sináptica aberrante y el inicio de trastornos neuropsiquiátricos.
stories.takeaway: Comprender el papel de los astrocitos en la ventana de desarrollo abre nuevas vías para intervenciones tempranas que prevengan o mitiguen trastornos mentales.
stories.paperTitle: Brain stars take the lead during critical periods of early postnatal brain development: relevance of astrocytes in health and mental disorders
stories.originalAbstract: In the brain, astrocytes regulate shape and functions of the synaptic and vascular compartments through a variety of released factors and membrane-bound proteins. An imbalanced astrocyte activity can therefore have drastic negative impacts on brain development, leading to the onset of severe pathologies. Clinical and pre-clinical studies show alterations in astrocyte cell number, morphology, molecular makeup and astrocyte-dependent processes in different affected brain regions in neurodevelopmental (ND) and neuropsychiatric (NP) disorders. Astrocytes proliferate, differentiate and mature during the critical period of early postnatal brain development, a time window of elevated glia-dependent regulation of a proper balance between synapse formation/elimination, which is pivotal in refining synaptic connectivity. Therefore, any intrinsic and/or extrinsic factors altering these processes during the critical period may result in an aberrant synaptic remodeling and onset of mental disorders. The peculiar bridging position of astrocytes between synaptic and vascular compartments further allows them to "compute" the brain state and consequently secrete factors in the bloodstream, which may serve as diagnostic biomarkers of distinct healthy or disease conditions. Here, we collect recent advancements regarding astrogenesis and astrocyte-mediated regulation of neuronal network remodeling during early postnatal critical periods of brain development, focusing on synapse elimination. We then propose alternative hypotheses for an involvement of aberrancies in these processes in the onset of ND and NP disorders. In light of the well-known differential prevalence of certain brain disorders between males and females, we also discuss putative sex-dependent influences on these neurodevelopmental events. From a translational perspective, understanding age- and sex-dependent astrocyte-specific molecular and functional changes may help to identify biomarkers of distinct cellular (dys)functions in health and disease, favouring the development of diagnostic tools or the selection of tailored treatment options for male/female patients.

An imbalanced astrocyte activity can therefore have drastic negative impacts on brain development, leading to the onset of severe pathologies. Clinical and pre-clinical studies show alterations in astrocyte cell number, morphology, molecular makeup and astrocyte-dependent processes in different affected brain regions in neurodevelopmental (ND) and neuropsychiatric (NP) disorders. Astrocytes proliferate, differentiate and mature during the critical period of early postnatal brain development, a time window of elevated glia-dependent regulation of a proper balance between synapse formation/elimination, which is pivotal in refining synaptic connectivity. Therefore, any intrinsic and/or extrinsic factors altering these processes during the critical period may result in an aberrant synaptic remodeling and onset of mental disorders. The peculiar bridging position of astrocytes between synaptic and vascular compartments further allows them to "compute" the brain state and consequently secrete factors in the bloodstream, which may serve as diagnostic biomarkers of distinct healthy or disease conditions. Here, we collect recent advancements regarding astrogenesis and astrocyte-mediated regulation of neuronal network remodeling during early postnatal critical periods of brain development, focusing on synapse elimination. We then propose alternative hypotheses for an involvement of aberrancies in these processes in the onset of ND and NP disorders. In light of the well-known differential prevalence of certain brain disorders between males and females, we also discuss putative sex-dependent influences on these neurodevelopmental events. From a translational perspective, understanding age- and sex-dependent astrocyte-specific molecular and functional changes may help to identify biomarkers of distinct cellular (dys)functions in health and disease, favouring the development of diagnostic tools or the selection of tailored treatment options for male/female patients.
